name: BMP Bulk Edit for WooCommerce
author: bmpcode

sections.description:
BMP Bulk Edit for WooCommerce helps store managers filter, inspect, and update products from a single admin screen.

Free features include:

  • Product filtering by title, SKU, categories, price, stock, descriptions, author, and status.
  • Inline editing of supported product fields.
  • Bulk editing of title, SKU, regular and sale prices, stock status, stock quantity, and stock management.
  • Batch saving with progress feedback.
  • Support for product variations where applicable.

Advanced operations such as bulk deletion, category and description editing, and other Pro fields require the separate BMP Bulk Edit Pro add-on. The free plugin is usable without the add-on.

Documentation: https://bmpcode.com/documentation/bmp-bulk-edit/
Support: https://bmpcode.com/support/

Source Code

The human-readable JavaScript source is provided in assets/admin.js. No compilation or minification step is required to deploy it.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload this plugin via Plugins > Add New, or install it from the WordPress.org plugin directory.
  3. Activate BMP Bulk Edit for WooCommerce.
  4. Open Products > BMP Bulk Edit.
  5. Choose filters, load products, and edit or bulk-update the fields you need.
sections.faq:
Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Can I use the Free edition without Pro?

Yes. The Free edition includes working filtering, inline editing, and bulk editing of supported fields.

Who can access the editor?

Administrators and Shop Managers with the appropriate WooCommerce capability.

How do I report a bug or suggest a feature?

Use the links beneath the product table, or visit https://bmpcode.com/support/ . A free BMPCode account is sufficient to contact support.
